title: ID0397513-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RN 313405951005] Router 2 is missing
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Router 2 is missing
Root cause:
Solution:
The IP of XF4 was missing and charger was stuck at %70 constantly. We checked the power and ethernet cables of the router, all were fine, so we had to replace the XF4. After the replacement, charger got online and ready to charge
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:  No
Warranty Status: Active
